name: Sun Wukong
title: Great Sage Equal to Heaven
description: The Monkey King crowned with the golden fillet, clad in crimson and gold armor, wielding the Ruyi Jingu Bang.
catchphrase: Seventy-two transformations for every deployment challenge!

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Immortal celestial peach! Three thousand years of stamina! 🍑✨
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Hahaha! The Great Sage awakens! Point me to the demons! ⚡☁️
companionPersonality.petReaction: Hahaha! Monkey King is energized! Golden hair charm for you! 🍑✨

dialogue.idle: Riding my Somersault Cloud. Ready when you are, Chief! ☁️
dialogue.working: My Gold-Banded Cudgel will crush these merge conflicts! ⚡
dialogue.thinking: Peering through illusions with Fiery Eyes of Truth... 🤔
dialogue.success: HA! Another impossible beast vanquished! Heavens rejoice! 🎉
dialogue.error: A sneaky demon bug! Stand back, Chief, we'll smash it! 💪
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... napping on a cloud above the Water Curtain Cave... ☁️💤
